name: Claude Auto Marshalling
author: izicubed
description: Two-layer marshalling. (1) Real-time marshalling — fully local, deterministic RSSI analysis on the timer itself, NO API key needed: during each race it detects gate passes the node missed (peaks below EnterAt, e.g. an unregistered holeshot), injects them at the true timestamp so lap counts are correct immediately, re-tunes EnterAt/ExitAt live, fixes stuck crossings, and learns per-pilot thresholds from saved races and from your manual marshalling. (2) Optional post-race AI marshalling: with an Anthropic API key and internet, saved races are re-tuned by the Claude API following the RotorHazard tuning methodology, with a preview-then-Apply workflow, native Marshal-page graph/lap-table integration, hard Minimum-Lap-Time and self-check safeguards, and a holeshot-aware lap count. Offline or keyless timers run the real-time layer alone. Panels support dark, light and auto themes.
